title: Introduce step-tiler quickstart with modular telemetry probes
author: Sofia Li
release_notes: Add lightweight step-tiler RAG quickstart; introduces retained-context snapshots and modular telemetry presets for local authoring and CI smoke tests.
description:
Summary: This PR adds a small, focused quickstart called the "step-tiler" that demonstrates a pattern for composing short RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) sessions into tiled, retainable steps. The goal is a developer-friendly example for iterative authoring: (1) checkpointing intermediate context (retained-context snapshots), (2) composing tiled prompts for long workflows, and (3) attaching lightweight telemetry probe presets that run in the dev loop and in CI. Motivation: teams building multi-step assistants frequently need an authoring pattern that preserves intermediate retrieval state and provides compact per-step observability without pulling in heavy telemetry stacks. This quickstart provides a minimal runner, docs, and CI smoke harness so engineers can iterate locally and validate regressions in PRs.

What changed (high-level commits):
- feat: add step-tiler quickstart skeleton and README explaining design and authoring flow (initial commit)
- feat: implement local TypeScript runner with retained-context snapshot API and typed tool contract examples
- docs: add authoring guide and examples for prompt tiling and snapshot debugging
- ci: add smoke test workflow to run quickstart scenario in headless mode on PRs
- perf: add a telemetry probe preset (compact probes.json) that emits the minimal spans/metrics used by the runner
- fix: update quickstarts CI workflow matrix to include node 18 and 20 runs

Files changed (high level):
- quickstarts/step-tiler/README.md — new developer guide and walkthrough
- quickstarts/step-tiler/runner.ts — lightweight local runner (TypeScript) for tiled steps and snapshot save/load
- quickstarts/step-tiler/templates/tiler-indexer.yaml — template for building a small vector index for examples
- quickstarts/step-tiler/examples/simple-tiler-config.json — sample config demonstrating tiled prompt boundaries
- examples/tiler-tool-contracts.ts — tiny typed tool-contract examples (fetcher, summarizer, indexer stubs)
- docs/authoring/step-tiler.md — docs site page describing patterns and recommended assertions
- telemetry/presets/compact-probes.json — probe presets used by runner + CI smoke job
- .github/workflows/quickstarts-ci.yml — added a quickstart smoke matrix job entry
- tests/quickstarts/step-tiler-smoke.spec.js — headless smoke test that runs the sample scenario

Checklist:
- [x] Quickstart provides README and runnable example
- [x] Local runner includes snapshot save/load and small API for retained context
- [x] Telemetry presets are compact and opt-in in the runner config
- [x] CI smoke job executes the scenario and asserts no regressions in token counts and telemetry
- [x] Docs site page added and linked from quickstarts index

Review conversation (summary as single string):
- Ravi: "Nice focused example — can we keep the telemetry preset opinionated but opt-in by default? Also request: include a small example assertion for token stability in the smoke test." 
- Sofia: "Addressed — telemetry is opt-in via quickstart config file and smoke test includes a token-count assertion (see tests/quickstarts/step-tiler-smoke.spec.js). I also added a short note in README about privacy considerations for snapshots."
- Elena: "Runner looks clean. Question on error handling: what happens when an indexer fails during a tiled run? Suggest adding retry/backoff and clearer error messages for authors."
- Sofia: "Added a basic retry wrapper to the runner with exponential backoff (max 3 attempts). Left a TODO to centralize retry policies in the shared devkit."
- Daniel: "CI change looks fine; please ensure the job is gated behind the quickstarts matrix to avoid extra runtime for unrelated PRs."
- Sofia: "CI workflow updated to run only when files in quickstarts/step-tiler/** or tests/quickstarts/** or docs/authoring/** change."
- Ravi: "Approving after the above tweaks." (approved)
- Elena: "LGTM — minor nits fixed in follow-up commit." (approved)

CI summary: The quickstart matrix job ran on node 18 and 20 in the PR test run. All checks passed on the final push. Notable checks: lint (pass), unit tests (pass), smoke-quickstarts (pass), docs build (pass). One intermittent failure on node 20 during an earlier run (external network timeout to the sample indexer) was retried and passed on rerun.

Local testing notes for reviewers: clone repo, cd quickstarts/step-tiler, npm ci, npm run build, npm run smoke-local. The runner will create a ./snapshots directory with retained-context JSON blobs; README warns not to commit these snapshots.

Compatibility and migration notes: This is a pure example/quickstart; no breaking API changes. The quickstart imports a small helper from devtools/utils but includes a vendorized copy to avoid coupling. If consumers want the shared implementation, the TODO points to ENG-2451 for extraction.

Merge outcome: merged by Elena Novak on 2025-09-05 via squash merge. Merge commit message: "Add step-tiler quickstart with compact telemetry probes (ENG-2451)". Backported to release/2025-09 branch via a separate cherry-pick PR.

Related: ENG-2451 (authoring patterns), PM-133 (quickstart enablement), follow-up planned to extract retry utility into devtools (ENG-2602).
